alignments.note: Construct noun אֹרֶךְ takes only its own English word. The chain's single written *the* belongs to the article morpheme on the rectum, not to a supplied article here (rule 29).

The rectum's article takes the one *the* the ASV writes for this chain, which English fronts to the phrase's left edge while rendering the rectum without an article of its own (*each curtain*) — rule 29's fronting clause, as in לֻחֹת הָאֲבָנִים → *the two tables of stone*. Of the phrase's two articles the first takes it (rule 47). Competing reading: mark this article `unrepresented` and give *The* to the construct as a supplied article; rejected because rule 29 supplies a *the* on a construct only where no article morpheme is present, and marks an article `unrepresented` only where the ASV writes no *the* for the phrase at all.
Nomen rectum with the relational *of* (rule 19); discontinuous around *each* (rule 25).
Agreement article on the attributive numeral; the phrase's one *the* is taken by the first article (rule 47).
אַחַת rendered by the determiner *each*. Because this numeral licenses the word, rule 41's determiner clause does not reach the articles.
Numeral predicate of a verbless clause; the construction-supplied copula joins the predicate (rule 20).
The waw standing between the two numerals the English *and* joins (rule 42).
Numeral.
The ASV writes *eight and twenty cubits* with no preposition (rule 40).
Assimilated article with no *the* written for it (rules 12, 29).
Counted noun.
Waw takes *and* (rule 14).
Construct noun רֹחַב takes only its own word; the second chain's single *the* likewise belongs to the article on its rectum (rule 29).
Numeral predicate of the gapped parallel clause; the ASV writes no second copula, so there is nothing further to place (rule 34).
No preposition written before *cubits* (rule 40).
Assimilated article with no *the* written (rules 12, 29).
Counted noun.

Article on the second chain's rectum, taking the fronted *the* on the same terms as s002: one *the* is written for the phrase, the rectum is rendered *each curtain* without an article of its own, and the first article takes it (rules 29, 47).
Nomen rectum with the relational *of*; discontinuous around *each* (rules 19, 25).
Agreement article on the numeral; the phrase's one *the* is taken by the first article (rule 47).
אֶחָת rendered by the determiner *each*.
Noun.
Numeral.
Possessive לְ in a verbless clause carries the *had* (rule 43).
Quantifier.
Article takes the *the* standing before its own word (rule 29).
Noun.

review_notes: Corrected: in both measurement chains the single written *the* goes to the present article morpheme on the rectum, fronted by English onto the construct, rather than to a supplied article on the construct while the present article is marked `unrepresented`. Rule 29 supplies a *the* on a construct only where no article morpheme is present and marks an article `unrepresented` only where the ASV writes no *the* for the phrase at all; EXO.36.29's *in the two corners* unit reads an identical shape the same way.
The determiner *each* stays with אַחַת/אֶחָת, so the agreement articles s004 and s020 remain `unrepresented` under rule 47.
*had* on the possessive לְ follows rule 43's verbless case.
